The learner asks specifically: Make sure one of the senses is this meaning: the brother of a parent.

notes: In Polish, the word 'wujek' is specifically used for the brother of your mother (or her sister's husband).
If you want to refer to your father's brother, the word is 'stryj', though in modern spoken Polish, 'wujek' is very commonly used for both sides of the family.
It is also a polite way for children to address an adult man who is a family friend, even if there is no blood relation.

examples.text: Mój wujek przyjedzie do nas w niedzielę.
examples.translation: My uncle is coming to visit us on Sunday.
examples.emotion: matter-of-fact, sharing a simple piece of family news

senses.definition: A polite term used by children to address an adult male friend of the family.
